in_hebrew.name: פדרו
in_hebrew.meaning: פדרו שמו של אבן, סלע, או פטרוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פדרו הוא השם העברי והערבי לפטרוס, שפירושו אבן, סלע. זהו שם שמקורו ביוונית القديمة פέτρα (Petra), שגם היא התפתחה מהמילה העברית פֶּדרָא. פדרו משמש כשם נביא ורועה, המייצג יציבות וכוח רוחני. השם מוכר גם בברית החדשה כפטרוס, אחד מתלמידי ישו.

in_greek.name: Πέδρο
in_greek.meaning: Πέδρο ο μαθητής και απόστολος του Ιησού
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Πέδρο είναι το ελληνικό ισοδύναμο του ονόματος Πέτρα (Petra), που σημαίνει πέτρα ή βράχος. Στο Χριστιανισμό, ο Πέδρο ήταν ένας από τους δώδεκα αποστόλους του Ιησού Χριστού και ο πρώτος επίσκοπος της Ρώμης. Το όνομα Πέδρο συμβολίζει την πίστη, τη σταθερότητα και την ηγετική θέση στην Εκκλησία.

in_latin.name: Petrus
in_latin.meaning: Petrus, discipulus et apostolus Iesu Christi
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Petrus, a Petro derivatum, significat 'petram' vel 'lapidem'. In Ecclesia Christiana, Petrus fuit unus ex duodecim apostolis Iesu Christi et primus episcopus Romae. Nomen Petrus importat fidem, stabilitatem et auctoritatem in Ecclesia Christiana.

in_english.name: Pedro
in_english.meaning: Rock, stone, or pebble, symbolizing stability and strength
in_english.long_meaning: The name Pedro originates from the Greek word 'Petra' (Πέτρα), meaning rock or stone. It is the Spanish and Portuguese equivalent of Peter, a significant figure in Christianity as one of Jesus' twelve apostles and the first bishop of Rome. The name Pedro signifies stability, strength, and spiritual leadership. Throughout Christian tradition, Pedro has been a popular name among saints, clergy, and laity alike.

data.cultural_impact: The name Pedro has a rich cultural history, particularly in the Spanish-speaking world. Throughout the history of the Spanish colonization of the Americas, Pedro was a common given name, possibly due to the influence of Saint Peter. The name became synonymous with strong and capable leadership, making it a popular choice for infants in many Latin American countries. Pedro has also been the name of several influential figures throughout history, including politicians, artists, and religious leaders, solidifying its importance in the cultural fabric of communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Pedro holds deep spiritual significance for Christians as it is derived from the name Peter, one of the twelve apostles and the leader of the early Christian Church. Peter was a humble fisherman whom Jesus chose to be the foundation of His Church. He was known for his boldness, love, and commitment to Christ, and his faith in Jesus led to his unwavering support throughout Christ's ministry. Pedro, as a representation of the disciple Peter, serves as a reminder of the power and importance of faith in one's spiritual journey. It is a name that carries the legacy of the early Christian Church and the steadfast leadership of Saint Peter.
